task_description: Fix 8 issues across User and Admin Flutter apps: deposit/withdrawal wallet crediting, KYC status icons, campaign form redesign, dark mode contrast, realtime subscriptions, Top Creators with follow/messaging, push notifications, and 2FA UI.

verification.summary: Cannot run flutter build/test/analyze due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode (Flutter SDK downloads are blocked). All verification performed by code inspection. CI will perform actual build validation on push.

review_fixes.v1: Fixed: messages realtime filter, follow re-entry guard, campaign cover image null, 2FA info box colors
review_fixes.v2: Fixed: (1) Added admin role check inside RPC function bodies - non-admin users now get 'Unauthorized: admin role required' exception. (2) Removed dead depositsRealtimeProvider and withdrawalsRealtimeProvider from wallet_provider.dart. (3) Wallet read-then-write documented as known limitation - no further changes needed.
